text:
Ravi K: Hey team, prepping launch comms for next month. Need a small design bundle for the inbound campaign + webinar: 1) Hero explainer diagram (how serving reduces per-request cost vs model ownership) - full slide + social crop, 2) three microtiles for email/social (throughput, latency tail, TCO), 3) a single-slide benchmark snapshot with anonymized numbers and an annotation for methodology. Brand-compliant, accessible, and ready for localization (EN -> ES/FR/JP). Launch kickoff: Wed AM - can we get first pass by Mon noon PT?

Mina L: Sounds good. Are we reusing the existing benchmark theme or do you want a fresh visual language? Also, do we need animated assets?

Ravi K: Prefer a fresh simplified treatment distinct from the big benchmark pack - something tighter for email/social. One short hero GIF for socials (3s). Static PNGs for microtiles. No long animations.

Sam T: tagging @DesignEdge for capacity. I can provide the anonymized datapoints and a 1-paragraph methodology blurb. We should keep all numeric labels rounded and avoid customer mentions.

DesignEdge: can do. Requesting: exact copy for tiles, preferred aspect ratios, and any mandatory legal footers. Also confirm color accents - if we change them need brand sign-off.

Ravi K: Copy: "Fewer tokens, lower cost. Faster responses." - Tile headers: Throughput, Tail latency, Unit TCO. Aspect ratios: hero 1200x628, tile 1200x1200 (square), bench slide 1920x1080. GIF 1200x628, 3s loop. Footer: include TM line and domain.

BrandBot: accessibility note: primary accent (#185FC6) OK at body size but low contrast for caption text; use #0B3A88 for captions or set caption >=14px bold. Also add ALT text for each exported asset and an 8px safe margin around logos.

DesignEdge: noted. We'll produce: SVG master + PNG exports at 2x for socials, 3 sizes for tiles (1200, 800, 600), and a GIF for hero. We'll add an accessibility variant (high contrast) and provide a README with filenames and export steps. ETA first pass: Mon 10:30am PT.

Sam T: datapoints (anonymized): baseline on-hosting: 1.0x cost, 120ms median latency, 10k qps; serving config: ~0.65x cost, 95ms median, 13k qps. Please show % savings not raw customer numbers. Method blurb: sample of 3 workloads, prefix caching + batching applied, synthetic traffic.

Lara (Legal): quick check 12: avoid implying guaranteed savings. Wording "up to" or "~" is fine. No customer names. Add trademark/legal footer on the bench slide. Also ensure any graph axis labels are generic.

Ravi K: good call. Use "~35% unit cost reduction" phrasing and add the TM footer on the bench slide.

DesignEdge: will mock up two diagram directions for the hero (left: comparative bars with callouts, right: simple flow that highlights caching/batching). Which do you prefer for the GIF?

Mina L: prefer the flow for GIF (more motion-friendly), bars for slide.

Ravi K: agree with @Mina L. Flow for GIF. Bars for deck.

BrandBot: compliance checklist: 1) color contrast AA at intended sizes, 2) ALT text provided, 3) 8px logo padding, 4) trademark footer present on bench slide, 5) accessible color-blind palette option included.

DesignEdge: adding color-blind friendly palette as alternate frames. We'll leave all text as editable layers for localization. Will tag the figma frames as: HERO_FLOW, HERO_BARS, TILE_THROUGHPUT, TILE_LATENCY, TILE_TCO, BENCH_SNAPSHOT, README_DELIVERABLES.

Sam T: placing the methodology doc + final copy in the campaign drive now. Link: https://drive.company/launch/inference-econ.

Ravi K: Perfect. Once first pass is in, I'll do copy QA and loop in localization. Please ping here when you upload and tag "Ready for review". Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

DesignEdge: will upload first pass by Mon 10:30am PT and drop assets in the drive.
